title: Three Winters and One Short Track
subtitle: 动物世界 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 动物世界（人与自然·自然生态·动物世界）
meta: 主题语境：动物世界（人与自然·自然生态·动物世界）　|　核心词汇：fox　|　正文 348 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 fox 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1961 the hunter ① tracked a fox that no keeper in the wood would have named, and he said the tracking was the whole of the winter. The ② fox, meaning the animal itself and not the hole, ran three winters and stayed unnamed in the book; a fox, he said, is the only thing in a wood that is judged by how long it is left unnamed.

Every ③ fox in that wood had the same short track beside it, and the ④ fox at the far bank, meaning the one they kept for the children and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A fox, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to name; the hunter said the naming is the part that fills three winters.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the fox was the whole of the matter, meaning the sly person and not the animal. The ⑥ fox, meaning the sly person and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody names; fox, he said, is either something you track or the only word that means both an animal and a sly person. He said the sly person is the part they remember.

By 1968 the ⑦ fox had become a line in a plan, and the plan had become an argument about the short track. The ⑧ fox of the whole thing, the hunter wrote in January, was one wood and three winters of naming; fox, he said, is either the one at the far bank or the reason you learned to name. He said the naming was never mentioned.

The ⑨ fox I remember is the one named in the plan, which closed in 1970 and is still described as the quietest in the wood. A ⑩ fox, my mother said in 1972, is the only one that improves by being named; every fox, she said, is a sly person that has agreed to look like an animal. She said the sly person was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 狐狸（指林子里每一只旁边的那一只）
B. n. 狐狸（指那一只本身，与洞穴相对）
C. 固定搭配：track a fox 追踪一只狐狸
D. n. 狐狸（指留给孩子们的那一只）
E. n. 狐狸（抽象总称，指一片林子的追狐之事）
F. n. 狐狸（指计划里写到、被说出名字的那一只）
G. n. 狡猾的人；老狐狸（old fox，指一件事里人人都等却无人说破的那样人）
H. n. 狡猾的人（抽象总称，指人人都等却无人说破的那样人）

items.q: tracked a fox that no keeper in the wood would have named
The fox, meaning the animal itself and not the hole

answers.why: track a fox 意为“追踪一只狐狸”，1961 年那位猎人追踪了一只林子里没有一位看守人肯说出名字的狐狸。
fox 意为“狐狸”，指那一只本身而不是洞穴，它经过了三个冬天而在簿子上没有被说出名字。
fox 意为“狐狸”，指林子里每一只旁边的那一只，每一只旁边都有同一串短短的足迹。
fox 意为“狐狸”，指留给孩子们的那一只，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
fox 意为“狡猾的人、老狐狸”，指一件事里人人都等却无人说破的那样人，叔叔说这个老狐狸就是那件事的全部。
fox 意为“狡猾的人”，指人人都等却无人说破的那样人而不是那只狐狸，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的人。
fox 意为“狐狸”，指计划里写到、被说出名字的那一只，到 1968 年这一只成了计划里的一行。
fox 意为“狐狸”，猎人一月写道，整件事的追狐之事是一片林子和三个冬天的说出名字。
fox 意为“狐狸”，我记得的是计划里被说出名字的那一只，1970 年结束了，至今仍被说成林子里最安静的一只。
fox 为抽象总称，母亲 1972 年说，一只狐狸是唯一会因为被好好说出名字而变得更好的东西。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1961 年那位猎人追踪了一只林子里没有一位看守人肯说出名字的狐狸，他说追踪才是那个冬天的全部。（track a fox）
那只狐狸，指的是那一只本身而不是洞穴，经过了三个冬天而在簿子上没有被说出名字。（fox）
那片林子里每一只狐狸旁边都有同一串短短的足迹。（fox）
最远那岸那只狐狸，指的是他们留给孩子们的那一只，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（fox）
叔叔说这个老狐狸就是那件事的全部，指的是那样人而不是那只狐狸。（fox）
1972 年母亲说，一只狐狸是唯一会因为被好好说出名字而变得更好的东西。（fox）
answers: In 1961 the hunter tracked a fox that no keeper in the wood would have named, and he said the tracking was the whole of the winter.
The fox, meaning the animal itself and not the hole, ran three winters and stayed unnamed in the book.
Every fox in that wood had the same short track beside it.
The fox at the far bank, meaning the one they kept for the children and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice.
My uncle said the fox was the whole of the matter, meaning the sly person and not the animal.
A fox, my mother said in 1972, is the only one that improves by being named.
